text_block_list.text:
One day, Марузенски and I go to the
cafeteria
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Be sure to try our new Glitter Shortcake!
It's
chock-full of silver sprinkles!
text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look, Trainer! That cake is so
fab! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look, Trainer! That cake is so
fab! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
It looks like a disco ball, doesn't it? Even
the
cakes are trendy here!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Nngh... Must... resist... Pull back... the
throttle...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh... Urrrgh... I have to be the last
one, the
very last...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Maya! What's the matter? You're
all
moaning and groaning.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Oh, heya, Maruzen! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Agh, I screwed up!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Maruzen. Hehe... It's so nice to
see you.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...Your mood really seems to be all over
the
place.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't happen to be working on
becoming
a "mature woman" again,
would you?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
That's right! That's exactly it! Right now,
I'm
practicing how to wait!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: How to wait... for what?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Glitter cake! I'm waiting until there's
only one left!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I wanna eat that cake so bad... but
mature women
wait!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you're letting other people get
theirs first.
That's certainly very mature
of you...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But isn't standing around gawking at
something
you want to eat a little silly?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I think you could use some adulting
advice from a
proper adult! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: You're the right person for the job, Марузенски.
Adults have a duty to lead the way.

text_block_list.text:
I think you could use some adulting
advice from a
proper adult! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: You're the right person for the job, Марузенски.
Adults have a duty to lead the way.

text_block_list.text: Oh-ho! ☆ I appreciate the nomination! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, going after what you want
without
thinking about it is the way to
go!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Really? Even as an adult? You don't wait
for
others to get theirs first?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Of course it'd be unbecoming of an
adult to take
everything for themselves...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But when something you like is in front
of you,
even adults can get a little
excited!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Wow! If someone super duper mega
mature like
you says so, it has to be true!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Um, what exactly do you mean by "super
duper
mega mature"?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, time to pull out of this holding

pattern! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And off she goes... Once she's set on
something,
she follows through in a
flash.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Is that the power of youth? If so, I'm not
about to
lose!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Wait up, Maya! I want some cake too! ☆
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Wow! Really?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's an adult's responsibility to
forge a
path for the young to follow! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Huh! That totally makes sense!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, you're always
rushing
ahead!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I do have a certain get-up-and-go
attitude, don't
I? ☆
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
And then at the end, you run out of gas
and just
stall out! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Urk!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I think I get it now! ☆ Thanks, you
two! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: G-go on and eat up...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
...I thought I was hiding my exhaustion
pretty
well, but she really has a keen
eye.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски
choice_data_list: That initial burst of speed is really important!

text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, exactly! Good point...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски looks a little upset, but
having the
cake that Маяно Топ Ган
brings back lifts her
spirits right back up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, Марузенски and Mayano Top
Gun enjoy
their cakes together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
